A profile carrying a single list handed that one list to both, so a WebGL1 context advertised names it could not return — a page asks getSupportedExtensions(), asks getExtension() for one of them, gets null, and has learned in two steps that the list was not written by a driver. The other half was quieter and worse: nothing was pinned for WebGL2, so the real driver's list went out there.
blocks.textZh: 两个版本支持的扩展不同。共用一张表会让 WebGL 1 声明无法读取的扩展，WebGL 2 也可能泄露实际驱动的列表。

blocks.text: Profiles that carry one list are now split as they load, each context losing the names it cannot have, so older profiles are fixed where they sit with nothing to regenerate. The split follows the browser's own registration lists rather than a table written by hand. Profiles that already declare both are used exactly as written.
blocks.textZh: 加载只有一张列表的旧配置时，浏览器会根据自身注册表为两个上下文各自过滤。已经声明两张列表的配置按原样使用。

entries.leadZh: WebGL 1 和 WebGL 2 分别使用各自的扩展列表。

entries.title: The screen a profile declares, on Windows and Linux
entries.lead: Every profile on one machine reported that machine's monitor, whatever screen it was given.

blocks.text: A profile's screen was replaced with the host display on every start. That was meant as a clamp — a window cannot be larger than the monitor it opens on — but outside macOS it ran even when the declared screen fitted easily. On a 5120 by 1440 monitor every profile said 5120 by 1440: one unusual pair, shared by the whole fleet, which is the opposite of what a per-profile screen is for.
blocks.textZh: 旧版每次启动都可能用实际显示器替换配置尺寸，即使声明尺寸完全装得下。

blocks.text: The declared screen is now kept whenever the real display can hold it, on every platform, and the clamp is left for the case it was written for. A profile created through the API with 1920 by 1080 keeps 1920 by 1080.
blocks.textZh: 现在仅在声明尺寸超出实际显示器时限制尺寸。通过 API 创建的 1920 × 1080 配置可保留该尺寸。

entries.leadZh: 实际显示器容纳得下时，保留配置声明的屏幕尺寸。

entries.title: The timezone a profile starts on
entries.lead: A geo lookup that fails now tries the others, and never falls back to your own clock.

blocks.text: The location of a proxy was read from one service only. ip-api, the default, has no HTTPS on its free tier, so a proxy that refuses plain HTTP failed on it and nothing else was tried. The launcher then fell back to this computer's own timezone and language without telling anyone — the one thing a profile must never show.
blocks.textZh: 此前只查询一个服务。免费版 ip-api 不支持 HTTPS，拒绝明文 HTTP 的代理可能导致查询失败，启动器随后会静默使用本机时区和语言。

blocks.text: All three services are tried now, the chosen one first, and the two others speak HTTPS. A service over its daily quota answers with an ordinary-looking 200 carrying an error inside, which used to count as a successful lookup that simply found nothing; that now counts as a failure and the next service gets its turn. When a proxy has no location the Test panel says why, on the proxy itself.
blocks.textZh: 现在最多尝试三个服务，优先用当前所选服务，两个备选支持 HTTPS。HTTP 200 中的配额错误会视为失败并切换，代理测试可显示查不到地区的原因。

blocks.text: And a profile behind a proxy no longer starts on this computer's clock at all. It starts on UTC, with a message on screen rather than a line in a log — UTC is wrong, but it is nobody's address. Without a proxy the host's own timezone is right, and on Windows the launcher can finally read it: it used to look only where Linux and macOS keep it, find nothing, and settle on UTC for every profile.
blocks.textZh: 代理配置地区未知时会以 UTC 启动并在界面提示。无代理时仍使用本机时区，Windows 也能正确获取该值。

entries.leadZh: 地区查询增加备选服务，代理时区查询失败时使用 UTC。

entries.title: A settings file that cannot be read
entries.lead: One stray byte used to wipe your settings and sign out every API client.

blocks.text: If anything went wrong while reading settings.json, the launcher quietly carried on with an empty set: the API off, its port at zero, the helper and the camera off, the theme blank. It then wrote that emptiness back to disk along with a fresh API key, so every token you had issued stopped working. A byte-order mark was enough — PowerShell writes one whenever you edit the file with Set-Content, and a plain redirect writes the file in an encoding the launcher did not read at all.
blocks.textZh: `settings.json` 读失败曾导致启动器用空值运行并把空设置和新密钥写回。Windows 编辑器写入 BOM 或系统编码就可能触发。

blocks.text: Now a file that cannot be read is left exactly as it is. The launcher runs on defaults for that session, says so at the top of Settings, and keeps your API key. Saving from that screen is refused while the file is unreadable, with a message saying why — because what is on screen are defaults, and writing them would replace whatever the file holds, the location of your profiles among them. Byte-order marks and UTF-16 are read correctly now, so the usual cause is gone.
blocks.textZh: 现在只在当前会话使用默认值，设置页显示原因并阻止保存，保留原文件和 API 密钥。文件读取支持 BOM 和 UTF-16。

entries.titleZh: 无法读取时保留设置文件
entries.leadZh: 配置文件读取失败时保留原文件与 API 密钥。

entries.title: Saving over someone else's change
entries.lead: The editor no longer reverts what the API changed while it was open.

blocks.text: Open a profile in the editor, change it from a script through the API, then press Save: the editor wrote its own copy over the top and your script's changes were gone, with nothing said. Every profile now carries a version number, and the editor remembers the one it opened. A save that would land on a newer version is refused, and the message tells you to reopen the profile and apply your changes to the current one.
blocks.textZh: 编辑器会记录打开时的配置版本。若外部已经改写到更新版本，保存会被拒绝，并提示重新打开配置后再应用更改。

blocks.text: The number only moves when the profile itself changes. Launching a profile records the time it started and closing it records how long it ran; neither is something an open editor disagrees with, and counting them would have refused your own save while blaming an API nobody had called.
blocks.textZh: 只有配置本身改变才会更新版本。启动时间与运行时长等记录不影响正在编辑的配置。

entries.leadZh: 编辑器不会覆盖打开之后由 API 写入的更新。

entries.title: “On startup” in the browser
entries.lead: A profile continues where it left off, and the setting decides — the launcher stopped overruling it.

blocks.text: Whatever you picked under “On startup”, the profile always reopened the tabs from last time. The launcher was passing “restore the last session” on every start, which overrides the setting, so “Open the New Tab page” could be checked and never take effect.
blocks.textZh: 启动器此前每次都强制恢复上次会话，选择“打开新标签页”也不生效。

blocks.text: The switch is gone and the answer moved to where it belongs. A profile now continues where it left off by default, and a choice made in settings is stored on the profile and wins over that default. Both entries do what they say, and nothing has to be checked to keep the behavior you already had.
blocks.textZh: 强制启动参数已移除。默认仍恢复上次会话，明确保存的启动选项优先。

blocks.text: Profiles made before this carry an explicit “New Tab page” that nobody chose — it was the browser's own default at the time and got written into the profile, so a new default alone would not reach them. That one value is now cleared once, on the next start, and the profile continues where it left off like the rest. A profile holding anything else picked it deliberately and is left alone, and this runs once: pick the New Tab page after it and it stays picked.
blocks.textZh: 旧配置若仅含当时自动写入的新标签页默认值，会在下次启动时清除一次。其他显式设置会保留，此后重新选择新标签页也会生效。

entries.leadZh: 启动行为遵循浏览器中的“启动时”设置。

entries.title: The debugging address on start
entries.lead: Starting a profile through the API waits longer for the address, and says why when it has none.

blocks.text: Starting a profile through the API sometimes answered with no cdp object, and the address turned up in the log a few seconds later. The wait was six seconds, which a cold start on Windows with a large profile can outrun. It is thirty now. When even that is not enough the answer carries a cdp_error saying what happened and where to read the address yourself, instead of leaving you to guess from a missing field.
blocks.textZh: 旧版只等待 6 秒，Windows 冷启动大型配置时可能没有 `cdp` 字段。现在等待 30 秒。仍未取得地址时，返回 `cdp_error`，并说明可以到哪里查看地址。

entries.leadZh: API 启动配置时会延长调试地址等待时间，并报告未取得地址的原因。

entries.title: The Python SDK on Windows
entries.lead: Profiles with non-English text no longer break the SDK.

blocks.text: On Windows the SDK read and wrote its files in whatever encoding the system happened to use, while every file it touches is UTF-8. A profile carrying a Spanish voice name, a Chinese one, or a note in Russian ended the first example in the README with UnicodeDecodeError. Worse in the other direction: the fingerprint handed to the browser was written in the local encoding, so those names reached it damaged. Every read and write is UTF-8 now.
blocks.textZh: Windows 上曾使用系统默认编码读取和写入文件，语音名称或备注含非英文字符时可能抛出 `UnicodeDecodeError`，写给浏览器的指纹也可能出现乱码。现在统一采用 UTF-8。

entries.leadZh: Python SDK 能读取包含非英文文字的配置。

entries.title: Chinese in the launcher
entries.lead: Every screen, switchable in Settings and picked up on its own on a Chinese system.

blocks.text: There is a Language setting at the top of Settings. On a system already set to Chinese the launcher starts in Chinese without being asked. It is the launcher's own text only — what language a site sees is the profile's, and that has always been separate.
blocks.textZh: 设置顶部提供语言选项。系统为中文时，启动器默认显示中文。网页使用的语言仍由浏览器配置决定。

blocks.text: 1479 pieces of text, covering every screen: the profile list and its editor, proxies and the ProxyShard pages, the automation project editor with its whole step library, extensions, bookmarks, the fingerprint library, the trash and settings, along with every message, prompt and confirmation they raise.
blocks.textZh: 新增约 1479 条界面文案，覆盖配置、代理、ProxyShard、自动化、扩展、书签、指纹库、回收站和设置，以及相应提示与确认框。

blocks.text: The text lives in shared/i18n/locales/en.json and zh.json under names like profileTable.lastRun, so rewording the English touches one line in one file instead of every place it is shown, and another language is one more file. `npm run check:i18n` fails the build if a new string is added without one, if a key is called that no locale has, or if the two files drift apart.
blocks.textZh: 文案以键值存放在 `shared/i18n/locales/en.json` 和 `zh.json`。`npm run check:i18n` 检查漏译、未知键和语言文件的键集合。

entries.leadZh: 启动器新增中文，可在设置中切换，也会识别中文系统。

entries.title: Refresh rate in the profile editor
entries.lead: Pick the rate the profile's screen claims, next to its cores and memory.

blocks.text: The browser learned to hold its frames to a rate the profile names, and the editor is where you name it: a Screen refresh rate list under CPU and memory, with the rates real panels ship with. 60 unless you change it, which is what most machines report.
blocks.textZh: 屏幕刷新率位于处理器和内存附近。列表提供常见面板刷新率，默认 60 Hz。

blocks.text: Frames can only be slowed down. A profile asking for more than this computer's own screen quietly runs at the screen's rate, so on a 60 Hz machine there is nothing above 60 to claim.
blocks.textZh: 浏览器只能降低帧率。如果配置指定的刷新率高于本机显示器，就使用本机显示器的刷新率。

entries.titleZh: 配置编辑器中的刷新率
entries.leadZh: 可在配置编辑器中设置屏幕刷新率。

entries.title: Ordering the profile list
entries.lead: By name, by age, by when it last ran, or by how much it has been used.

blocks.text: The list only ever came in the order profiles were added. Under Filters there is now an Order setting: name A→Z or Z→A, newest or oldest first, last launched, or most used. It is remembered between restarts, and selecting a range with shift follows what you see rather than the old order.
blocks.textZh: 筛选中新增排序选项，支持名称正序或倒序、最新或最早创建、最近启动及使用最多。排序会在重启后保留，按住 Shift 选择范围时也按当前顺序。

entries.leadZh: 配置列表可按名称、创建时间、最后启动或使用次数排序。

entries.title: Cookies in the profile editor
entries.lead: Pick a cookies file while making the profile instead of afterwards.

blocks.text: Loading cookies meant creating the profile, finding its row and using the menu. The editor has a Cookies block now: pick the file there and it is loaded the moment the profile is saved. Same JSON array as before, and the same rule — the profile has to be stopped, which a profile being created is.
blocks.textZh: 编辑器新增 Cookie 区域，保存后立即加载所选文件。格式仍是 JSON 数组，且仅在配置停止时才能导入。

entries.leadZh: 新建配置时可直接选择 Cookie 文件。

entries.title: The icon in the macOS menu bar
entries.lead: It follows the light and dark bar instead of staying purple.

blocks.text: The launcher put its full-color mark in the menu bar, where every other icon is a plain stencil that turns dark on a light bar and light on a dark one. It is drawn from the mark's shape now, the way macOS expects.
blocks.textZh: 菜单栏改用由原标志轮廓生成的单色图标，浅色背景下显示为深色，深色背景下显示为浅色。

entries.leadZh: macOS 菜单栏图标随明暗外观切换。

entries.title: The UDP test with a VPN running
entries.lead: A VPN could make the launcher decide a working proxy had no UDP, and start profiles with QUIC and WebRTC switched off.

blocks.text: Before starting a profile the launcher checks whether the proxy can carry UDP, and turns QUIC and WebRTC off when it cannot. The check was one probe: send a packet, wait for an answer. It could not tell apart a proxy with no UDP and a computer that could not send the probe in the first place.
blocks.textZh: 启动器会检测代理的 UDP 能力。此前一次探测没有响应，就可能关闭配置的 QUIC 和 WebRTC。

blocks.text: Some VPNs filter UDP per application. On one of those the launcher's probe got nothing while the browser on the same machine, at the same moment, went through the same proxy without trouble. The proxy was fine; the launcher's own packet never left. Every profile then started with QUIC and WebRTC removed.
blocks.textZh: 某些 VPN 按应用过滤 UDP，启动器的探测无法发出，而同一代理在浏览器中仍然可用。

blocks.text: The launcher now checks whether it can send UDP from this machine at all before reading anything into the result. When it cannot, it says so and leaves the profile alone rather than deciding on the proxy's behalf.
blocks.textZh: 启动器现在先判断本机能否发出 UDP。无法完成这一步时会提示原因，并保留配置原有设置。

entries.titleZh: VPN 环境下的 UDP 检测
entries.leadZh: 修复 VPN 阻挡检测报文时误判代理不支持 UDP 的问题。

entries.title: Finger gestures outside the desktop app
entries.lead: The touch steps existed only in the Automation editor. Nothing outside it could tap, swipe or turn a phone.

blocks.text: A phone profile has no cursor, and the browser enforces that: it refuses pointer commands on a phone and finger commands everywhere else. The Automation editor knew this and had the gestures — tap, long press, swipe, drag, pinch. Nothing else did. Over MCP an agent driving a phone profile got a refusal from every click and every field it typed into, with nothing to say why. The SDKs had no input layer at all, and neither the API reference nor the read-me mentioned any of it.
blocks.textZh: 移动配置只接受触控动作。此前手势仅在项目编辑器提供，MCP 和 SDK 无法执行对应操作。

blocks.text: The gestures are now on every surface. MCP gained six tools — tap, long press, swipe, drag, pinch and rotate — and the existing human ones stopped needing to be told which kind of profile they are on: on a phone a click becomes a tap, a right click becomes a long press, and filling a field taps it first. Moving the cursor is the one that still refuses, because hovering has no touch equivalent and a tap in its place would be a different thing that looked like it worked.
blocks.textZh: MCP 新增轻触、长按、滑动、拖动、双指缩放和旋转。在移动配置中，原有点击映射为轻触，右键映射为长按，填表前会先轻触字段。悬停没有触控等效动作。

blocks.text: Fixing that turned up a second thing: over MCP the human pointer and typing had never worked at all. The input domain is built from the tab behind the session, and the server was asking for one that has no tab, so every human click and every human keystroke came back "no live frame" — on desktop profiles too, not only phones. It now asks on the page.
blocks.textZh: 同时修复 MCP 从没有活动标签页的会话请求输入域时出现的 `no live frame` 错误。现在从实际页面请求输入域。

blocks.text: All three SDKs gained the input domain, pointer and finger both. The API reference lists the touch steps with their parameters, and the read-me describes the whole domain, including the parts that were already there and undocumented — scrolling with the device the profile's platform implies, and pressing a named key through the profile's own keyboard layout.
blocks.textZh: 三个 SDK 都加入了鼠标和触控输入域，API 文档和自述文件补充参数及原有滚动和按键行为。

blocks.text: Turning the screen is new everywhere, including the editor, where it is the Rotate screen step. The turn is physical: the sensors move first and the picture commits at the end, the order a real handset produces. A profile with no motion sensors refuses it — a device with no accelerometer cannot notice it has been turned.
blocks.textZh: 编辑器也新增旋转屏幕步骤。传感器先变化，再提交屏幕旋转；没有运动传感器的配置会拒绝此操作。

entries.titleZh: 桌面应用外的触控操作
entries.leadZh: 移动触控步骤可通过 MCP、SDK 和自动化编辑器使用。

entries.title: Every preset showing a GPU mismatch
entries.lead: The check that reads this machine's GPU asked on a page where the answer is never available.

blocks.text: The launcher starts the engine once to learn what the host GPU can do, and compares presets against it. It asked on a blank page — and WebGPU is only exposed on a page with a real origin, so the question came back “there is no adapter here”. That was written down as fact: no adapter features at all, and every preset in the library then looked like it claimed more than the machine had.
blocks.textZh: 启动器曾在空白页探测本机 GPU。WebGPU 要求有效页面来源，因此得不到适配器，导致指纹库的配置都被误判为超出本机能力。

blocks.text: The check now runs on a real page and gets the real answer. An empty adapter list is also no longer accepted as one: a working machine does not report zero features, so that is a question that failed, and it is asked again next time instead of being cached until the engine version happens to change.
blocks.textZh: 现在使用具备有效来源的页面，并将空适配器功能列表视为探测失败。失败结果不缓存到下一次引擎更新，下次会重新检查。

entries.titleZh: 安全上下文中的 GPU 检测
entries.leadZh: GPU 能力检查改在可使用 WebGPU 的页面运行。

entries.title: Screen resolution in the profile editor
entries.lead: On Windows and Linux you can now pick one, and only sizes this monitor can actually show are offered.

blocks.text: A resolution list sits under the refresh rate for Windows and Linux profiles, defaulting to whatever the fingerprint carries. The list stops at this machine's own monitor: a window cannot be larger than the screen it opens on, so a bigger claim is contradicted by the window the moment a page reads it.
blocks.textZh: 配置编辑器在刷新率下方提供分辨率列表，默认沿用指纹尺寸。候选尺寸不会超过本机显示器。

blocks.text: The available area keeps the fingerprint's own inset — the strip a taskbar or menubar occupies — rather than being invented, because a screen whose usable height equals its full height is a screen with no system chrome, which no ordinary desktop has. macOS has no such control: there the profile's own screen was already kept as written.
blocks.textZh: 可用区域保留指纹中的任务栏或菜单栏边距。macOS 不提供这个控件，仍按原方式保留配置屏幕尺寸。

entries.titleZh: 配置编辑器中的屏幕分辨率
entries.leadZh: Windows 和 Linux 配置可从本机显示器支持的尺寸中选择分辨率。

entries.title: Fonts on a mobile profile
entries.lead: A profile claiming a phone reports the fonts that phone has, and none of the machine's own.

blocks.text: A page learns which fonts you have by measuring text, and a phone profile used to measure the fonts of the computer it was running on — a page could find Apple Chancery, or Segoe UI, on a device that has neither. The profile now carries the device's own set, and that set is all a page can find.
blocks.textZh: 网页可通过测量文字判断字体是否存在。此前手机配置会暴露本机字体，例如手机并没有的 Apple Chancery 或 Segoe UI。现在仅提供目标设备的字体集合。

blocks.text: Names the device really has answer as present even when the machine has no such file, because the browser draws them with a face it does have. What cannot be reproduced is the exact shape of the letters: the widths are the stand-in's. A detector holding a table of real widths can still tell; one asking which fonts exist cannot.
blocks.textZh: 本机缺少对应字体文件时，浏览器用替代字体绘制，并仍将该名称报告为存在。测得的字宽来自替代字体，因此无法精确复现字形。

blocks.text: The set is written as groups, because a phone's font configuration mostly is: on Android, Arial, Helvetica, Tahoma and Verdana are one file, and a page measuring all four gets one width. Android profiles carry their maker's own fonts too — Samsung, Motorola, OnePlus, Xiaomi and vivo each add their own.
blocks.textZh: 手机字体按组配置。例如 Android 的 Arial、Helvetica、Tahoma 和 Verdana 共用一个文件，测出的宽度相同。配置也包含三星、摩托罗拉、一加、小米和 vivo 的专有字体。

entries.leadZh: 移动配置只向网页报告目标手机的字体。

entries.title: WebGPU on a Linux profile
entries.lead: A profile claiming Linux gave the machine's own graphics adapter away.

blocks.text: Chrome on Linux ships with WebGPU switched off, so a page asking it for an adapter is answered with nothing. Ours answered with the adapter of the machine it ran on — vendor "apple", architecture "metal-3", beside a WebGL string naming an NVIDIA card on a Mesa driver. It now answers with nothing, the way Chrome on Linux does. navigator.gpu stays where it is; it is the adapter request that comes back empty.
blocks.textZh: Linux 版 Chrome 默认关闭 WebGPU，适配器请求返回空结果。此前这里可能报告 Apple 的 `metal-3`，同时 WebGL 又报告 NVIDIA 显卡和 Mesa 驱动。现在仅改变适配器请求结果，`navigator.gpu` 属性仍然保留。

entries.leadZh: Linux 配置不再暴露本机的图形适配器。

entries.title: Protected video on Android profiles
entries.lead: An optional switch for the video a phone can play and a desktop cannot.

blocks.text: Almost any current phone plays protected video at a level no desktop offers, and a site that checks gets a different answer from a profile claiming a phone. Turn on Media in the profile editor and the profile claims it. It is off by default and only offered on mobile profiles, because the claim is only as good as the machine behind it: a site that takes it up will ask for video this computer may not be able to decode.
blocks.textZh: 在配置编辑器中启用“媒体”后，移动配置会声明受保护视频的播放能力。该选项默认关闭，且仅适用于移动配置。实际播放仍取决于本机能否解码。

entries.titleZh: Android 配置的受保护视频
entries.leadZh: 新增移动配置的受保护视频能力选项。

entries.title: Turning the screen
entries.lead: A mobile profile can be turned, and everything turns with it.

blocks.text: Over the debugging port, Motion.setOrientation turns the claimed screen. The screen, the window, the media queries a page lays itself out with and the motion sensors all follow — and the sensors travel through the turn the way a hand does rather than jumping, because a device that arrives at a new angle without having moved is not a device.
blocks.textZh: 通过调试端口调用 `Motion.setOrientation` 可旋转配置的屏幕。屏幕、窗口、页面布局使用的媒体查询和运动传感器都会随之更新，传感器读数会连续经过旋转过程。

entries.leadZh: 旋转移动配置时，显示和传感器会一同更新。

entries.title: Dragging with a finger
entries.lead: A new step for carrying something across the page, where a swipe only flicks it.

blocks.text: A swipe scrolls; a drag moves the thing under the finger. The finger now rests long enough for the page to decide it is a drag and not a scroll, then travels from where it came to rest — which is what a slider, a map or a sortable list needs. Automation reaches it as Motion.touchDrag, and the launcher's own drag step uses it on a mobile profile.
blocks.textZh: 滑动用于滚动，拖动用于移动手指下的内容。手指先短暂停留再开始移动，适用于滑块、地图和排序列表。自动化可通过 `Motion.touchDrag` 调用，启动器也用它执行移动配置的拖动步骤。

entries.leadZh: 新增拖动页面元素的步骤。

entries.title: Graphics features in profiles
entries.lead: Profiles carry the WebGPU features of the device they were taken from.

blocks.text: A page can list those features in one call, and a list belonging to a different card than the one the profile names is a contradiction. Every profile in the library now carries its own, and the browser never reports more than the machine can actually back.
blocks.textZh: 网页能一次获取完整列表。指纹库中的每个配置都带有自己的列表，浏览器报告的功能以本机实际能提供的能力为上限。

blocks.text: Fixed along the way: the warning about a feature your machine cannot provide was shown for every profile at once, because the list of what this machine supports had been recorded before there was anything to record. A missing record is no longer read as "supports nothing".
blocks.textZh: 修复因过早记录本机能力而给所有配置显示警告的问题。缺少记录时会视为未知。

entries.leadZh: 配置保留采集设备的 WebGPU 功能列表。

entries.title: Mobile profile
entries.lead: A profile claiming a phone now reports one consistently: its connection, orientation, fonts and motion sensors all agree with the device it says it is.

blocks.text: The connection block takes raw values now — the ones the device would have measured — and the browser rounds them the way it rounds real ones. A profile pinning 75 ms used to report exactly 75, which no Chrome reports, and the same number to every site. Add "type" to name the link, for example "cellular4g".
blocks.textZh: 网络配置接收设备测量的原始值，再由浏览器按规则取整。此前写入 75 毫秒时会原样报告给所有网站。可用 `type` 指定连接类型，例如 `cellular4g`。

blocks.text: Screen orientation follows the screen the profile already sets, so a portrait phone no longer says landscape. There is no separate setting for it, on purpose: a second place to state which way the device is held is how the two ended up disagreeing.
blocks.textZh: 屏幕方向由配置中的屏幕尺寸推定。竖屏手机会报告竖屏，无需另设屏幕方向。

blocks.text: Fonts match what a phone has: the local font list is gone, the decorative generic families collapse onto the default as they do on Android, and text scaling works. Page text may render slightly differently on a mobile profile as a result.
blocks.textZh: 移动配置使用手机字体集合。Android 的装饰性通用字体族回退到默认字体，文字缩放也会生效。页面文字的呈现可能略有变化。

blocks.text: Motion sensors report a device being held. Add "motion": { "carry": "hand" } — or "table" or "walking" — to choose how much it moves. Without them a page listening for movement heard nothing at all, which no phone does.
blocks.textZh: 运动传感器可报告设备的携带状态。用 `"motion": { "carry": "hand" }` 模拟手持，也可选择 `table` 或 `walking`。

entries.leadZh: 移动配置的网络、屏幕方向、字体和传感器读数会与所声明的设备保持一致。

entries.title: Touch
entries.lead: A profile can now claim a phone, and the browser behaves like one: your mouse and wheel reach the page as finger touches, not as a cursor.

blocks.text: Set the profile's platform or user agent to Android, or turn on the mobile client hint, and the page reports touch points, a coarse pointer and no hovering — the same set a real phone reports.
blocks.textZh: 将平台或用户代理设为 Android，或启用移动客户端提示后，网页会读取到触点、粗略指针和不支持悬停等手机特征。

blocks.text: From then on the wheel scrolls the page by dragging a finger, a click is a tap, dragging is a swipe, and the right button opens the touch context menu by holding. Moving the mouse without a button does nothing at all, because a phone cannot hover.
blocks.textZh: 滚轮转为手指滚动，点击转为轻触，拖动转为滑动，右键转为长按并打开触控菜单。未按键时移动鼠标不会产生触控动作。

blocks.text: This changes what you can do by hand: selecting text by dragging works the way it does on a phone, not the way it does on a desktop. Scrolling with a trackpad still carries momentum; scrolling with a notched wheel does not, for the same reason a slow finger drag does not.
blocks.textZh: 拖动选择文本遵循手机交互。触控板滚动保留惯性，带刻度的鼠标滚轮滚动无惯性。

blocks.text: Automation gets four steps over the debugging port — tap, hold, swipe and pinch. The pointer steps refuse on a mobile profile and say so, because a phone moving a cursor contradicts itself.
blocks.textZh: 自动化调试端口提供轻触、长按、滑动和双指缩放。移动配置会拒绝鼠标指针步骤并说明原因。

entries.leadZh: 移动配置把鼠标和滚轮操作转换成触控输入。

entries.title: Automation
entries.lead: A new section for building and running your own scripts against your profiles.

blocks.text: A project is a list of steps. Add them from a library grouped by what they do — navigation, pointer, keyboard, flow, data — and fill in each step's fields.
blocks.textZh: 从导航、指针、键盘、流程和数据等分类中添加步骤，然后填写每一步的参数。

blocks.text: Every step says where the run goes next, both when it works and when it does not: on to the next one, jump to another step, try again, end the pass, or stop this profile. Failure stops by default, because carrying on after a click that found nothing is how a run ends up typing into the wrong page.
blocks.textZh: 每一步可分别指定成功和失败后的动作，包括继续、跳转、重试、结束本轮或停止当前配置。步骤失败时默认停止，避免后续输入误落到其他位置。

blocks.text: Open a profile inside the section and its window appears next to the list. Click, type and scroll straight on it. Right-click offers what to do with whatever is under the cursor; shift and right-click opens the page's own menu instead. Turn recording on and everything you do is written down as you go — clicks, keys, scrolling and the pages you open.
blocks.textZh: 在自动化页面打开配置后，浏览器窗口会出现在步骤列表旁。右键提供当前元素可用的动作，按住 Shift 再右键可打开网页自身菜单。录制会记录点击、按键、滚动和导航。

blocks.text: Every click and keystroke — yours and the project's — goes through the browser's own human-input engine. A site sees a person moving a mouse, not a script firing events.
blocks.textZh: 手动操作和项目步骤产生的点击、按键均使用浏览器自己的输入引擎。

blocks.text: Run a project against as many profiles as you like, several at a time, for a number of passes or for a number of hours. The Fleet window shows every browser in the run and which step it is on, and each run keeps its own log on disk.
blocks.textZh: 项目可并行运行多个配置，按轮次或总时长结束。Fleet 窗口显示各浏览器的当前步骤，每次运行的日志会写入磁盘。

blocks.text: A project can be exported to a file and imported somewhere else. Any module its steps use goes inside the file, so the project runs where it lands; a module already installed under the same name is kept as it is rather than replaced. Any field you mark as secret is left blank on the way out, and you are told what to fill in on the way back.
blocks.textZh: 项目可导出并在其他电脑导入。文件包含依赖的模块，导入时保留已安装的同名模块。标记为秘密的字段不会写入文件，导入时会提示重新填写。

blocks.text: You can add your own blocks by writing a small module in Rust. It never touches the page: it is handed the step's settings and answers with ordinary actions the launcher performs itself. Modules are added and removed at the bottom of the Automation section, and the steps they bring sit in the library in a group of their own.
blocks.textZh: 可用 Rust 编写自定义步骤模块。模块只接收步骤参数并返回启动器要执行的动作。可在自动化页面底部管理模块，模块提供的步骤会单独分组。

entries.leadZh: 新增自动化页面，可为配置编排和运行项目。

entries.title: Automation from a script
entries.lead: Projects can now be run from outside the app.

blocks.text: Everything the Automation section does — list projects, read one, replace it, run it, see how a run is going, stop it, export and import — now has an address on the launcher's local API, and the MCP server has a tool for each. Until now a project could only be started by hand in the window.
blocks.textZh: 本地 API 和 MCP 支持列出、读取、替换、运行、查看进度、停止、导出及导入自动化项目。以前只能从应用窗口启动。

blocks.text: It uses the same token as the rest of the API, from Settings → Automation API. Modules are covered too: list what is installed, add a .wasm from a path on this machine, remove one.
blocks.textZh: 沿用设置中“自动化 API”的访问令牌。模块也可通过 API 列出、从本机路径添加 `.wasm` 文件或移除。

entries.titleZh: 通过 API 运行自动化
entries.leadZh: 可从应用之外运行自动化项目。

entries.title: Screen scaling
entries.lead: Two ways a page could read the real scaling of your monitor, and one way it could catch the profile out by zooming.

blocks.text: A CSS paint worklet has a screen-scaling number of its own, and it was answering with the machine's, not the profile's. Any page could read it in three lines and no permission is asked for it — next to a window that claimed something else, that is a plain contradiction. The screen-details API, the one behind the window-management permission, gave the real number away the same way, alongside a screen whose width and height were the profile's.
blocks.textZh: CSS Paint Worklet 和需窗口管理权限的屏幕详情接口此前会报告本机缩放比例，导致同一页面可能同时读到配置的屏幕宽高和本机缩放。

blocks.text: The third one needed no trick at all: on a real machine the reported scaling includes the page's zoom, so it moves the moment you press Ctrl-+. The profile's number stayed put, and a page that compares the window's width against the viewport's could see a page zoomed to 110% still insisting nothing had changed. The zoom is now carried on the profile's number too, so it moves exactly as far as it should. The screen's own figure, which carries no zoom on a real machine either, stays put as it should.
blocks.textZh: 网页缩放现在会计入配置的窗口缩放读数。例如用 `Ctrl` 加 `+` 调到 110% 后，窗口和视口读数会相应变化，屏幕自身的缩放读数则保持固定。

entries.leadZh: 修正两处显示缩放读值，并使窗口缩放随网页缩放更新。

entries.title: Scroll numbers
entries.lead: A page could tell the browser apart by what one turn of the wheel reported.

blocks.text: The window reports the screen scaling its profile claims, and the numbers a wheel produces were being divided by that instead of by the machine's own. One notch arrived as 50 pixels with a wheelDelta of 60, where a real mouse reports 100 and 120 — and a wheelDelta that is not a multiple of 120 is a value no wheel produces. This hit a person scrolling with their own mouse, not only scrolling the browser performs itself.
blocks.textZh: 滚轮此前按配置声明的屏幕缩放换算，每格可能上报 50 像素及 `wheelDelta` 60，而普通滚轮对应的示例值为 100 和 120。手动滚动也受影响。

blocks.text: The division now uses the machine's real scaling, so a notch reports what a notch reports everywhere. The page still reads the profile's scaling from window.devicePixelRatio, unchanged. The correction that used to sit on the browser's own scrolling is gone with it: it straightened only what the browser sent itself, and in synchronized windows it had to be skipped or the copies scrolled twice as far.
blocks.textZh: 滚轮现在按本机实际缩放换算。网页通过 `window.devicePixelRatio` 读取的仍是配置的缩放。旧版浏览器内部滚动的补偿已移除，避免同步窗口重复放大偏移量。

entries.leadZh: 滚轮每格上报的数值恢复正常。

entries.title: Arranging browsers on Linux
entries.lead: Windows would not move into place in a Wayland session.

blocks.text: Arranging is each browser putting its own window where it was told, and a Wayland window is not allowed to do that — the request goes nowhere and the desktop places the window as it sees fit. Browsers now start on X11, which inside a Wayland session means XWayland, so arranging works again both in the sync panel and during a run.
blocks.textZh: Wayland 不允许应用自行定位窗口。浏览器现在用 X11 启动，在 Wayland 会话中经 XWayland 运行。同步面板和自动化可重新排列窗口。

blocks.text: Nothing changes if you already log in with Xorg, and your own --ozone-platform in the extra launch arguments still wins. If the session has no X server at all, the browser stays a Wayland window and the automation page now says exactly what that costs — which it used to get wrong, calling everything limited even where arranging was fine. The launcher's own Fleet window still cannot sit above the others under Wayland; nothing in the app can change that.
blocks.textZh: Xorg 用户沿用原行为，手动设置的 `--ozone-platform` 优先。没有 X 服务器时仍用 Wayland，自动化页面会说明限制。启动器的 Fleet 窗口在 Wayland 下仍无法置顶。

entries.leadZh: 恢复 Wayland 会话下的浏览器窗口排列。

entries.title: Requests and dragging
entries.lead: Projects can now drag things and send requests of their own.

blocks.text: Dragging was the one gesture missing: the browser could move, click, scroll and type, but not press, carry and let go. It can now — "Drag onto" takes one element to another, and "Swipe" presses and moves by a distance, which is what a slider, a canvas or a sweep that selects text needs. Both travel the same human path as an ordinary movement, and the moves carry the held button, without which a page sees a pointer that merely passed over it.
blocks.textZh: “拖到目标”可把一个元素拖到另一个元素，“滑动”可按指定距离执行按下、移动和松开。移动事件会保留按键状态，适用于滑块、画布和拖选文字。

blocks.text: "Send a request" goes out from the launcher rather than from the page, with a TLS fingerprint you choose — chrome_140, firefox_133, safari_18 and a hundred more — and, by default, through the profile's own proxy, so a call made beside a browsing session comes from the same address. Name a session and cookies and connections carry from one step to the next; leave it empty and the request goes alone. The answer arrives as three names: the body, and beside it the status and the headers.
blocks.textZh: “发送请求”由启动器发出，可选与 Chrome、Firefox 或 Safari 对应的 TLS 配置，默认使用当前配置的代理。指定会话名可在步骤之间复用 Cookie 和连接，留空则独立发送。输出包含正文、状态和响应头。

items: **Waiting**: until an element is gone, until it says something, until the address changes.
**Reading**: how many elements match, an element's attribute, a picture of the page.
**Choosing**: a random number or an item from a list, and a line taken from a file — removed as it is read, so a list of accounts is used once each.
itemsZh: **等待**：等待元素消失、出现指定文本或页面地址改变。
**读取**：读取匹配元素的数量、元素属性或页面截图。
**选择**：随机取数、从列表选取一项，或从文件取出一行并在读取后移除这一行。

entries.leadZh: 自动化项目新增拖动与独立发送请求的步骤。

entries.title: Human input over the debugging port
entries.lead: Automated movement and typing failed on every profile started for automation.

blocks.text: The browser only builds its human-input commands when it is told to, and the launcher never told it. Anything driving a profile through the debugging port — the MCP server included — got "command not found" the moment it tried to move the pointer.
blocks.textZh: 启动器此前没有显式启用输入命令，通过调试端口控制配置时会收到“找不到命令”，MCP 也受影响。

blocks.text: It is now switched on whenever a profile is started with the debugging port open. Nothing is added to what a page can see.
blocks.textZh: 启用调试端口启动配置时会注册这些命令，网页能看到的接口保持原样。

entries.titleZh: 调试端口上的人工输入
entries.leadZh: 修复为自动化启动的配置无法移动指针或输入文字的问题。

entries.title: Window size on Windows and Linux
entries.lead: Profiles opened in a window smaller than the monitor, and maximising did nothing.

blocks.text: A profile carries the screen of the machine its fingerprint was taken from, and the browser both sizes the window to that screen and refuses to let the window grow past it. A profile created on another machine, or added through the API, therefore opened small on a bigger monitor, and pressing maximise only moved the window to the middle of the screen.
blocks.textZh: 此前按采集指纹的屏幕尺寸打开并限制窗口，较小屏幕上创建的配置迁到大显示器后仍以小窗口打开。

blocks.text: On Windows and Linux the screen is now taken from the monitor in front of you every time a profile starts, not only when the profile is created, so the window opens at the size of the desktop and maximises normally. macOS still uses the screen from the fingerprint, unless the real display is smaller than it claims. Settings → Screen resolution set to Real reports the host monitor on every system.
blocks.textZh: Windows 和 Linux 每次启动时按当前显示器设置窗口尺寸。macOS 仍采用指纹中的屏幕尺寸，除非实际显示器更小。各系统将“屏幕分辨率”设为“真实”后都会报告本机显示器。

entries.titleZh: Windows 和 Linux 窗口尺寸
entries.leadZh: 修复跨电脑导入的配置窗口过小且无法最大化的问题。

entries.title: Synchronized windows
entries.lead: You work in one window; every other window in the group repeats the same actions in its own profile.

blocks.text: Pointer, keystrokes, scrolling, opening and closing tabs, extension popups. It is not a recording played back: each window performs the action with its own motor profile, so the windows never move identically.
blocks.textZh: 同步指针、按键、滚动、标签页开关和扩展弹窗。同组各窗口用自己的动作参数执行。

blocks.text: There is no leader to appoint. Whichever window you are typing in is the one driving, because it is the one receiving real input. Switch windows and it follows.
blocks.textZh: 当前接收真实输入的窗口负责驱动其他窗口。切换输入窗口即可更换来源。

blocks.text: The fill helper is deliberately excluded. In a group every window fills the same form at the same moment with its own generated person, so mirroring those keystrokes would put one window's answers into everyone else's fields.
blocks.textZh: 表单填写助手不参与输入镜像。同组各窗口同时填写同一表单，但各自使用自己的生成数据。

blocks.text: Fixed: a window that came up zoomed, full-screen or minimised ignored the layout, because in those states the window state owns the geometry. It now leaves that state first. The chosen layout is also remembered, so a profile that finishes starting after the others is placed too.
blocks.textZh: 修复了最大化、全屏或最小化窗口忽略布局的问题。窗口先退出当前状态再排列。已选布局会保留，较晚启动完成的窗口也会排进去。

blocks.text: Fixed: a tab opened by a site — `target=_blank` or `window.open` — stayed behind in the other windows when it was closed. Such tabs are never broadcast, since every window opens its own from the same mirrored click, so there was no name to close by. They now get a name both sides work out independently, and the close carries the page address as a check, so a window that finds something else under that name leaves it alone.
blocks.textZh: 修复由网站通过 `target=_blank` 或 `window.open` 打开的标签页关闭后仍留在其他窗口的问题。各窗口独立生成标签页名称，关闭时还会校验页面地址。

entries.leadZh: 在一个窗口操作，同组窗口会在各自的配置中执行相应动作。

entries.title: Human typing in the browser
entries.lead: Right-click a field and the browser types into it the way a person does.

blocks.text: The context menu of any text field, search box or `contenteditable` gets two entries: **Human Type**, which types the clipboard, and **Fill with generated**, a submenu of eight values generated for this profile — name, surname, email, username, phone and the rest. Each entry shows the value it will type.
blocks.textZh: 文本框、搜索框和 `contenteditable` 区域的右键菜单新增两个选项：**人工输入**逐字键入剪贴板内容，**填入生成值**提供此配置生成的八种值，包括名字、姓氏、邮箱、用户名和电话。每个选项会显示要输入的内容。

blocks.text: The text is not set on the element and not pasted. It goes in key by key, through the same path a keyboard uses:
blocks.textZh: 文本通过和键盘相同的路径逐键输入。

items: gaps between keystrokes vary instead of being a fixed delay
timing depends on the letter pair — `th` is faster than `qz`, as it is for a person
keys overlap: the next goes down before the previous comes up
a per-character bias that belongs to the profile and survives restarts
optional typos, made and corrected with a real backspace
itemsZh: 间隔随相邻字符而变，例如 `th` 比 `qz` 更快。
相邻按键可重叠，前一个键松开之前，下一个键就已按下。
配置会保留每个字符的时间偏移，重启后仍然生效。
可选择模拟误输入，并用退格键修正。

blocks.text: The pointer moves the same way, with overshoot and correction, and takes longer to reach a small target than a large one. Password fields are excluded.
blocks.textZh: 指针也会模拟移动过头后的回调，到达较小目标所需时间更长。密码字段不参与。

blocks.text: No JavaScript is injected. The whole path is C++ inside the browser process, so a page cannot detect a script that was never there.
blocks.textZh: 整个输入流程由浏览器进程中的 C++ 实现，无需向网页注入 JavaScript。

entries.leadZh: 右键点击输入区域，浏览器即可按模拟人工输入的方式逐字键入。

entries.title: Human typing over CDP
entries.lead: The same typing and pointer engine, driven from a script.

blocks.text: The commands live in a `Motion` domain on the browser target. It does not appear in `/json/protocol` or `Schema.getDomains`, and the command names deliberately do not match those of other automation tools.
blocks.textZh: 命令位于浏览器目标的 `Motion` 域。该域不列在 `/json/protocol` 或 `Schema.getDomains` 中，命令名也与其他自动化工具不同。

blocks.text: Create the pointer first: a session without one answers every other command with an error rather than guessing where the cursor is, since a guessed starting point gives the wrong duration and the wrong curve. Pass the element's real width as `targetWidth` — that is what makes the timing believable.
blocks.textZh: 先创建指针。没有指针的会话会对后续调用报错，避免因猜测起点而算错耗时和轨迹。`targetWidth` 取元素的实际宽度，用于计算移动时间。

blocks.text: Worked example in the README, section “Human input over CDP”.
blocks.textZh: 完整示例见上游 README 的「Human input over CDP」一节。

entries.titleZh: 通过 CDP 的人工输入
entries.leadZh: 脚本可调用同一套输入与指针引擎。

entries.title: Camera
entries.lead: The profile has a camera even on a machine that has none, and it shows the photo or video you pick.

blocks.text: The machine's camera list is replaced, not added to. A page never reaches the real camera — which matters because the profile's fingerprint already names a specific camera model, and handing over the host's would contradict it.
blocks.textZh: 浏览器用配置中的设备列表替换本机摄像头列表，使网页读取到的设备与配置中声明的型号保持一致。

blocks.text: Pick the file from the control left of the app menu while the browser is running. PNG, JPEG, MP4, MOV, WebM, Y4M and MJPEG are accepted, and the format is detected from the file's contents, so a wrong extension does not matter. Video loops, so a short clip is enough.
blocks.textZh: 浏览器运行时，在应用菜单左侧的控件中选择文件。支持 PNG、JPEG、MP4、MOV、WebM、Y4M 和 MJPEG，并按文件内容识别格式。视频会循环播放。

blocks.text: The panel shows the first frame with a selection rectangle: drag inside it to move, drag a corner to resize, and the numbers beside it let you write a framing down and repeat it. The rectangle keeps the camera's aspect ratio, so the picture is never stretched or letterboxed. For a portrait or square photo there is a checkbox that fits the whole image instead and fills the space beside it.
blocks.textZh: 面板在首帧显示裁剪框。拖动框内可移动，拖动角点可缩放，旁边的数值可记录并复现构图。裁剪框保持摄像头宽高比。纵向或方形照片也可选择显示整幅图像，并填充两侧的空间。

blocks.text: What a page gets is a camera, not a file:
blocks.textZh: 网页看到的摄像头具备以下特性。

items: the device name and id are the profile's, not the path to your file
a normal ladder of resolutions, not just the one the picture happens to be
pan, tilt and zoom crop the picture for real, and are reported as supported only when the model the profile claims has them
frames carry sensor noise, so no two are identical — a page comparing consecutive frames does not see a frozen image
frame timing has a millisecond or two of jitter, as real hardware does
itemsZh: 设备名称与 ID 来自配置，网页看不到文件路径。
平移、俯仰和缩放会实际调整裁剪范围，仅在配置所用型号支持时报告相应能力。
画面加入传感器噪点，相邻帧并非完全相同。
帧间隔有约一至两毫秒的抖动。

blocks.text: With nothing picked the camera still works and shows a dark frame, rather than failing. A camera that enumerates and then never delivers is itself detectable.
blocks.textZh: 未选择文件时仍会输出暗色画面。

entries.leadZh: 即使电脑没有摄像头，此配置也能用选定的图片或视频作为画面。

entries.title: Form filling helper
entries.lead: The browser finds the fields, offers them, and fills them on one button.

blocks.text: Enabled per profile. The browser watches the page, offers the fields it can fill, and on one press types them in one at a time. Generated identities are stable per profile: the profile is the account, and an account has one owner.
blocks.textZh: 按配置启用。浏览器观察页面并列出可填字段，点击一次便会按顺序填入。每个配置对应一组固定的生成信息。

blocks.text: Three sources are used, each answering one question:
blocks.textZh: 字段识别和填写依赖三类信号。

items: **Autofill** — what a field is: a first name, a year of birth, a gender.

**The accessibility tree** — whether the element is still there, where, and whether it is shown. Read fresh several times over the first seconds of a step, and matched by element id rather than position, because two steps of one signup can occupy the same rectangle.

**Focus after the click** — whether the click landed. Nothing in the browser process knows what is painted on top of what, so if another element took the focus the field is skipped instead of typed into blind.
itemsZh: **自动填充信息**识别字段用途，例如名字、出生年份和性别。
**无障碍树**提供元素是否存在、位置及可见状态。步骤开始后的数秒内会重复读取，并按元素 ID 匹配，以区分占据同一位置的不同步骤。
**点击后的焦点**用来确认目标是否收到点击。若焦点落到了其他元素，就跳过当前字段。

blocks.text: Drop-downs built from a `div` and a `ul`, which autofill cannot see, are found through the accessibility tree and filled by clicking the box and then the option.
blocks.textZh: 对由 `div` 和 `ul` 实现的下拉菜单，借助无障碍树找到控件，再依次点击菜单和选项。

blocks.text: Fixed: a signup that swapped its step inside one document left the helper offering the previous step's fields, so filling put a name into the date row. Three causes: the old step stayed in autofill's cache, the old fields were laid out underneath the new ones at the same coordinates, and a step that starts hidden was parsed once at load with every field marked unfocusable and never re-read. The accessibility tree now settles all three.
blocks.textZh: 修复同一文档中切换注册步骤后仍显示旧字段的问题。自动填充缓存、同位置重叠的字段以及初始隐藏步骤都曾造成错误。现在根据最新的无障碍树重新判断。

blocks.text: The offer also settles itself: the page is looked at several times over the first seconds of a step, so a half-parsed form corrects itself instead of waiting for you to touch something.
blocks.textZh: 步骤出现后的数秒内会多次读取页面，表单尚未解析完时也能自行更新可填字段。

entries.leadZh: 浏览器列出可填的字段，可一次启动逐项填写。

entries.title: Human input in MCP
entries.lead: The Motion domain wrapped so a model can aim at an element instead of a coordinate.

blocks.text: The bundled MCP server gains `human_click`, `human_move`, `human_fill` and `human_type`. They take the same selectors as the existing browser tools; the wrapper resolves the element, scrolls it into view and passes the engine its coordinates together with the element's real width, which is what makes a small target take longer to reach.
blocks.textZh: 随附的 MCP 服务增加 `human_click`、`human_move`、`human_fill` 和 `human_type`。它们使用与现有浏览器工具相同的选择器，将元素滚到可见范围，再把坐标和宽度交给引擎。

blocks.text:
human_fill(profile_id, "#email", "ada@example.com")
human_fill(profile_id, "#email", "new@…", clear: true)
human_click(profile_id, "button[type=submit]")

`clear` selects the current value with a triple click rather than a keyboard shortcut, so the clearing is as human as the typing. Give `x` and `y` instead of a selector when the coordinates are already known. The calls take real time and report how long the move and the typing took.
blocks.textZh: `clear` 通过三击选择当前值。已知坐标时，可提供 `x` 和 `y`。调用会等待操作结束，并报告移动和输入耗时。

entries.leadZh: MCP 封装 Motion 域，可按元素定位。

entries.title: Per-profile window icon
entries.lead: Each profile's window shows its own name and color.

blocks.text: In the Dock, the taskbar and Alt-Tab you see which profile you are switching to. The name is set as large as it fits, wrapping to at most three lines; a name too long to fit is trimmed with an ellipsis.
blocks.textZh: 在程序坞、任务栏或 Alt+Tab 中可区分各个配置。名称字号会适应空间，最多显示三行，超长部分用省略号表示。

blocks.text: The icon is shaped the way each system shapes its own: a squircle with a shadow on macOS, a full-bleed rounded square on Windows, an Adwaita outline on Linux.
blocks.textZh: 图标遵循各系统样式。macOS 使用带阴影的圆角方形，Windows 使用铺满的圆角方形，Linux 采用 Adwaita 轮廓。

blocks.text: Nothing to set up. Rename a profile and its icon follows on the next launch.
blocks.textZh: 无需额外设置。重命名后，下次启动会更新图标。

entries.leadZh: 每个配置的窗口图标显示独立的名称和颜色。

entries.title: Profile color
entries.lead: One color per profile, on its window icon and behind its name in the omnibox.

blocks.text: Pick it in the profile editor. The window icon takes it, and so does the pill carrying the profile's name in the omnibox, so the two never disagree about which profile you are looking at.
blocks.textZh: 在配置编辑器中选色，窗口图标和地址栏里的名称标签会使用该颜色。

blocks.text: Left on **Auto** the icon derives a color from the name — the same profile always the same color, and the thing you can still tell apart at 32 px — while the pill keeps the browser's own toolbar color and follows the theme.
blocks.textZh: 保留 **自动** 时，图标从配置名称派生固定颜色，便于在 32 像素大小下区分。名称标签继续使用浏览器工具栏颜色，并随主题变化。

blocks.text: `color` is a field on profile create and edit, so a scripted fleet can come out color-coded.
blocks.textZh: 通过脚本创建或编辑配置时也可以设置 `color` 字段。

entries.leadZh: 窗口图标与地址栏中的配置名称可以使用同一颜色。

entries.title: Extension library
entries.lead: Add an extension once, then pick it per profile.

blocks.text: **Library → Extensions** → *From link*: give it a Web Store address and the extension downloads itself. Pasting just the id out of the address works too, as does a direct link to a `.crx` or `.zip`. A file or an unpacked folder can be added the same way.
blocks.textZh: 在 **库 → 扩展** 中选择从链接添加。支持 Chrome 网上应用店地址、扩展 ID、`.crx` 或 `.zip` 直链，也可添加本地文件或已解压的目录。

blocks.text: Each one shows its name, version, description and icon, read out of the extension itself — so what the grid shows is what the browser will load. In the profile editor they are chips: check the ones this profile should run, and different profiles can carry different sets.
blocks.textZh: 扩展的名称、版本、描述和图标直接读取自扩展本身。在配置编辑器里可勾选该配置需要运行的扩展。

blocks.text: Removing an extension from the library stops every profile loading it from its next start; profiles hold a reference, not a copy.
blocks.textZh: 从扩展库移除后，各配置从下次启动起不再加载它。配置保存的是对库条目的引用。

blocks.text: Also over the API and MCP: `POST /extensions` takes the same link, and a profile's `extensions` is a field on create and edit.
blocks.textZh: API 和 MCP 也支持此流程。`POST /extensions` 接受同样的链接，创建或编辑配置时可提交 `extensions` 字段。

entries.leadZh: 扩展只需加入库一次，各配置可分别勾选。

entries.title: Folder bookmarks
entries.lead: A site bound to a folder appears in the bookmarks bar of every profile in that folder.

blocks.text: **Library → Bookmarks**: add a site, pick the folder. Every profile in that folder gets it in a bookmarks-bar folder called **ShardBrowser**, from its next launch. Bound to no folder means every profile.
blocks.textZh: 在 **库 → 书签** 添加网站并选择文件夹。下次启动时，书签会出现在该文件夹内各配置书签栏的 **ShardBrowser** 目录中。留空则应用到所有配置。

blocks.text: Only that folder is managed. Bookmarks saved inside a profile are left alone, and a site removed here disappears from the profiles on their next launch.
blocks.textZh: 应用只管理这个书签目录，配置内自行保存的书签会保留。从库移除的网站会在配置下次启动时从托管目录移除。

blocks.text: Also over the API and MCP: `GET`/`POST /bookmarks`.
blocks.textZh: API 和 MCP 也支持 `GET` 和 `POST /bookmarks`。

entries.leadZh: 绑定到文件夹的网站，会出现在该文件夹内所有配置的书签栏。

entries.title: Trash
entries.lead: A deleted profile is kept for 7 days and can be restored with its cookies and logins.

blocks.text: Deleting a profile now moves it to **Trash**, restorable for seven days. What comes back is the account — cookies, saved logins, site data, preferences, history and bookmarks — under the same id, so anything that referenced the profile still points at it.
blocks.textZh: 删除配置会将它移入 **回收站**，七天内可以恢复。Cookie、保存的登录资料、站点数据、偏好、历史和书签按原配置 ID 恢复，已有引用仍然有效。

blocks.text: Caches are not kept, which is why a profile that took a gigabyte sits in the trash as a few megabytes. Deleting a folder together with its profiles goes through the trash too.
blocks.textZh: 缓存不会保留，因此回收站占用通常比运行时目录小。删除文件夹及其配置也会经过回收站。

blocks.text: After seven days it is gone. **Empty trash** does it sooner.
blocks.textZh: 七天后配置会清除，也可提前选择 **清空回收站**。

blocks.text: Also over the API and MCP: `DELETE /profiles/{id}` archives, `GET /trash` lists, `POST /trash/{id}/restore` brings it back.
blocks.textZh: API 和 MCP 同样支持此流程。`DELETE /profiles/{id}` 移入回收站，`GET /trash` 列出条目，`POST /trash/{id}/restore` 恢复。

entries.leadZh: 删除的配置会保留七天，可以连同 Cookie 和登录资料一起恢复。

entries.title: Profile data location
entries.lead: Move profiles, extensions and the trash to another folder or disk.

blocks.text: **Settings → Profile data location** → *Change…* and pick a folder on any disk. Moving shows a progress bar; nothing in the old folder is deleted until every file has arrived and been checked, so a failure part-way leaves you exactly where you were.
blocks.textZh: 在 **设置 → 配置数据位置** 中选择更改，再选择目标目录。迁移期间显示进度，等所有文件复制并验证后才删除旧数据。中途失败时仍保留原目录。

blocks.text: Profiles cannot be launched while the move runs — including from the API, so a script cannot start a browser mid-move. Close every running profile first.
blocks.textZh: 迁移前须关闭运行中的配置。迁移期间禁止从界面或 API 启动配置。

blocks.text: A disk mounted read-only is refused before anything is copied, rather than half-way through.
blocks.textZh: 复制前就会拒绝只读目标磁盘。

entries.leadZh: 可将配置、扩展和回收站迁移到其他目录或磁盘。

entries.title: Extra launch arguments
entries.lead: Switches added to every profile launch.

blocks.text: **Settings → Extra launch arguments**, one per line or space-separated; quote a value containing spaces. They are applied last, so a switch here also overrides the launcher's own.
blocks.textZh: 在 **设置 → 额外启动参数** 中填写，每行一个或用空格分隔。包含空格的值加引号。额外参数最后应用，可以覆盖启动器提供的同名参数。

blocks.text: Put anything that changes what a page can measure in the profile instead. A switch applied to every profile at once makes them all alike.
blocks.textZh: 会改变网页可读取特征的参数宜在各配置中单独设置。全局参数会作用于所有配置。

entries.leadZh: 为每个配置的启动命令追加指定参数。

entries.title: Proxy names
entries.lead: `host:port:user:pass #facebook` — what follows the hash is the proxy's name.

blocks.text: The name is shown first in the profile's proxy list and in the proxy table, with the address after it. Set it when creating or editing a proxy, or write it into the line you paste. Bulk import reads it and export writes it back.
blocks.textZh: 配置的代理选择列表和代理表格会在地址前显示名称。可在创建、编辑或粘贴时指定。批量导入读取名称，导出也会保留。

blocks.text: Leave the name empty and the field's placeholder shows the address it will fall back to. The country is not something you write down — the proxy test fills it in.
blocks.textZh: 留空时使用地址作为名称，输入框会显示对应提示。地区由代理测试回填。

entries.leadZh: 粘贴代理地址时，可用 `#` 后面的文字指定名称。

entries.title: Distributing proxies
entries.lead: Select proxies, press Distribute, check the pairing, bind.

blocks.text: The dialog puts the two lists side by side and pairs them by position — proxy #1 to profile #1 — so you can check the pairing before binding. One proxy per profile: if the proxies run out, the remaining profiles are left alone rather than sharing an IP.
blocks.textZh: 对话框并排展示代理和配置，按顺序配对，确认前可以查看。每个配置分配一个代理，数量不足时，剩余配置保持原状。

blocks.text: It applies to profiles **without a proxy** by default. Switch it to all profiles to reassign existing ones; it shows how many bindings would be replaced before you confirm.
blocks.textZh: 默认仅分配给 **未绑定代理** 的配置。切换为全部配置时，确认前会提示将替换多少现有绑定。

entries.leadZh: 选中代理后可预览与配置的对应关系，再批量绑定。

entries.title: Adding a proxy from the profile editor
entries.lead: Add and bind a proxy from the profile's own proxy list.

blocks.text: **Create new proxy** sits at the top of the profile's proxy list — the place you are already looking when you find the proxy you wanted is not there. Paste one line and it is read the way bulk import reads it: `host:port`, `host:port:user:pass`, `user:pass@host:port` or a `socks5://` URL, with a trailing `#name`.
blocks.textZh: 配置的代理列表顶部可选 **创建新代理**。粘贴一行即可识别 `host:port`、`host:port:user:pass`、`user:pass@host:port` 或 `socks5://` 链接，末尾可加 `#name`。

blocks.text: What was understood is shown before anything is saved. Saving adds it to the proxy list and binds it to the profile you are editing.
blocks.textZh: 保存前可核对识别结果。保存后会新增代理，并绑定当前编辑的配置。

entries.titleZh: 从配置编辑器添加代理
entries.leadZh: 可在配置编辑器中添加代理，并直接绑定当前配置。

entries.title: Row selection and filters
entries.lead: Shift-click selects a run of rows; filters narrow the profile list.

blocks.text: Shift-click spans from the last row you clicked to the one you shift-click, on both the profiles and the proxies table, and anywhere on the row rather than only the checkbox.
blocks.textZh: 配置表与代理表都支持按住 Shift 点击，从上次点击的行选到当前行。可点击整行。

blocks.text: The row you shift-click decides the direction: an unchecked row checks the whole run, a checked one clears it. That is also how a run selected by mistake is undone.
blocks.textZh: 当前行未选中时，选中整个区间。当前行已选中时，取消整个区间。

blocks.text: Profiles filter by whether they are running, by the country of the bound proxy and by whether there is a proxy at all. The button carries a count so you can see when a filter is hiding something.
blocks.textZh: 配置可按运行状态、所绑代理的地区以及是否绑定代理筛选。筛选按钮显示计数，提示当前列表受筛选影响。

entries.leadZh: 按住 Shift 点击可选择连续行，配置列表可按状态和代理筛选。

entries.title: Noise for temporary profiles
entries.lead: `POST /profiles/temporary` takes a noise block.

blocks.text: A temporary profile can now set noise per vector instead of taking the default, which is everything off:
blocks.textZh: 临时配置可分别设置各项噪声，省略时默认关闭。

blocks.text: `true` turns a vector on with the strength the UI uses; a full block sets the details. A vector you leave out stays off. The same argument reaches the bundled MCP server as `create_temporary_profile`'s `noise`.
blocks.textZh: `true` 按界面默认强度开启对应项，也可用完整对象指定细节。未指定的项目保持关闭。随附 MCP 服务的 `create_temporary_profile` 同样接受 `noise`。

blocks.text: Leave `seed` out. Two temporary profiles created a second apart still get different fingerprints.
blocks.textZh: 可以省略 `seed`。短时间内创建的两个临时配置也会生成各自的指纹。

entries.leadZh: 创建临时配置时可提交 `noise` 参数。

entries.title: Fixes
entries.lead: Two places where the launcher's lists were out of date.

items: **A proxy added on the Proxies page was missing from the profile editor** until the app was restarted. It appears immediately now, and a proxy bound by the distribute dialog shows up in the profiles table the same way.
**Country, region and city in the ProxyShard residential generator had no search.** They are searchable now, as is the location picker on the buy card.
itemsZh: **代理页新增的代理立即出现在配置编辑器中。** 批量分配对话框绑定代理后，配置列表也会立即更新。
**ProxyShard 住宅代理生成器支持搜索国家、州省和城市。** 购买卡片中的地区选择器也支持搜索。

entries.leadZh: 修复代理列表刷新和住宅代理地区搜索。

entries.title: Engine update detection
entries.lead: A rebuilt engine now reaches you even when the Chromium version has not changed.

blocks.text: The update check only compared Chromium versions, so a second engine build on the same version — new patches, same upstream, which is most releases — was never offered. Three things now say an engine has moved: the Chromium version, the build stamp the release carries, and the archive itself.
blocks.textZh: 过去只比较 Chromium 版本，同一版本加入新补丁后重新构建，启动器无法发现。现在还会比较发布中的构建标识和归档文件。

blocks.text: A release can also state the launcher version it needs. When it wants a newer one than you are running, the engine update is held back and the launcher update is what you are told about instead — a browser the launcher cannot configure looks like a broken profile rather than a missed update.
blocks.textZh: 引擎发行可以声明所需的最低启动器版本。当前启动器过旧时，暂缓更新引擎并先提示更新启动器。

entries.leadZh: Chromium 版本不变时，也能发现重新构建的引擎。

entries.title: Patch log after an update
entries.lead: Opens automatically on the first run after an update.

blocks.text: Shown once per version. After that the app opens where it always did.
blocks.textZh: 每个版本自动显示一次，之后应用按正常方式打开。

entries.leadZh: 更新后首次运行会自动打开更新内容。
